example: Spearheaded a team of 10 engineers to deliver the product 2 weeks ahead of schedule.
Architected a scalable microservices backend that reduced latency by 40%.

content: Use the XYZ format for bullet points: Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].
example: Increased revenue by 10% (X) measured by Q3 sales (Y) by implementing a new email campaign (Z).

content: Always include numbers to quantify impact.
example: Instead of 'Improved performance', write 'Reduced page load time by 1.2 seconds, increasing conversion by 5%'.
Deployed scalable applications using AWS EC2, S3, and Lambda.
Trained predictive models using PyTorch to forecast demand with 92% accuracy.
